name: Intelligent Robots with a Sense of Smell
description: The exercises will contain practical implementation tasks in Python and the Robot Operating System (ROS2). In particular, the exercises will cover a short introduction to ROS2, how to read data from gas and environmental sensors, how to discriminate different gases with sensors, how to model and estimate a gas distribution, and how to localize a gas source with a mobile robot.
prerequisites: The exercises require knowledge provided by the lecture “Intelligent Robots with a Sense of Smell “. The practical exercises will require programming in Python and basic Unix knowledge.
